precedent.title: Device-archetype resource alignment — one class, one budget
precedent.summary: Device-archetype resource alignment — one class, one budget
precedent.full_reasoning: Per-human conductor resources are a CLASS property (deviceArchetype), not an instance one. The floor-only conformance check (validate-deployments.ts, `>= archetype floor`) lets any human sit anywhere above its floor, so firefighting drifts the tree: the ONE crashlooping instance gets bumped while the rest of its archetype is left behind (2026-07: home-nuc held 1000m/2000m/3000m across pete/gertrude/eve for the SAME device class). This inverts control — the archetype budget in genesis/data/devices/archetype-resource-budgets.json is the CANONICAL value each consolidated human derives; a human that differs must say WHY via `resourceOverride: { <field>, justification }` (adam, the genesis anchor + doorway-B backend, is the model: an explicit role-justified 8000m over the 4000m family-node base). When an OBSERVATION says a class needs more, move the budget once (realigns the whole class) rather than editing an instance. `ask` tier: surfaces the drift + names each offending human, one keystroke (EPR_META_ACK=1) to proceed; dismissals aggregate for drift review. Static observation, no live metrics dependency — the value is reasoned once and held by the class.

precedent.title: Plane location — name the plane before binding any concern
precedent.summary: Before any concern binds, the symptom names its plane — custody/availability · reach/audience · head/version, plus the truth-vs-projection distinction. A cure applied to the wrong plane is a defect even when locally correct.
precedent.full_reasoning: This is the one class a SHARP AUTHORITY CANON ACTIVELY WORSENS: eight authority-flavoured concerns make every symptom look like an authority problem, so C0 is evaluated before them and its answer is recorded on the finding. Reach (audience, earned) != content_head (version, declared) != replication (availability, custody) — three orthogonal planes; and REA's monotonicity guard living in the PROJECTION rather than in DHT truth is exactly where C0 and C2 meet. Authority split with the seam-map atlas: the atlas §4 concern-routing table remains the ROUTING authority (where a concern lives); this canon is the GUARANTEE authority (what must hold). When they disagree, route by the atlas, then correct whichever recorded the world wrong.
precedent.scope_json: {"appliesTo":"Every diagnosis, every design gate, every finding triage. Evaluated FIRST, before any other class. precedent.title: Anti-self-election — no component crowns what it authored
precedent.summary: No component crowns what it authored — except through the guarded legitimate arm: self-candidacy is admissible exactly when `not_retrievable` itself proves a local chain exists. A flat prohibition would forbid a cure the fleet depends on.
precedent.full_reasoning: Self-election is the authority family's most-recurrent class and its cures keep landing one call site at a time — the third site (a terminal write) was invisible to BOTH sweeps already guarding the first two. The guarantee is therefore stated over the DECISION POINT SET, not over a call site: a seam answers C1 by enumerating every path that can crown, including terminal writes, or it declares n-a. The legitimate arm is part of the guarantee because the 2026-08-02 cure depends on it — a component MAY stand as its own candidate when the refusal evidence (`not_retrievable`) is itself proof that a local chain exists; that is evidence, not self-preference. steward/node's `consensus.rs` leader election is the standing unbound seam where C1 is the definitional question.

precedent.title: Contract-evolution honesty — an unknown field is rejected or observed, never defaulted
precedent.summary: A wire/config/schema contract change is rejected or observed, never defaulted — an unknown or renamed field fails the parse or increments a counter.
precedent.full_reasoning: Both instances share one shape: the contract MOVED and the consumer's default absorbed the move, so the failure surfaced as behaviour, months or a release later, with no parse error and no counter anywhere. precedent.full_reasoning: C5 and C12 are deliberately separate classes because a system can be perfectly careful about what it BELIEVES and still act on an unverified permission: I1 (verification terminates in the receiving peer's own conductor) has only ever been proven for HEADS, never for permissions, and today's commitment gate sits at the courier rather than at the acting node. precedent.summary: Every authority gate serving a lower social tier is LABELED as a scaffold AND names its successor criterion and graduation trigger on the notarized reach vocabulary (`REACH_LEVELS`) — at the gate site, not only in a doc or backlog.

precedent.title: Witnessed residual — the outcome set closes with an arm that is witnessed, never dropped
precedent.summary: Every decision point's outcome set closes with a residual arm that is WITNESSED, never dropped: an exception fitting no class is captured with a context capsule sufficient for cross-node RCA (inputs digest, decision state, the clocks/lags/peer-states in play), carried as evidence, delivered to the developer-facing RCA report, and DISPOSITIONED — cure, declared variance, or a new concern class via the calibration ledger's miss-of-canon intake.
precedent.full_reasoning: The canon, matrix and forecast govern the ANTICIPATED. A distributed, diverse fleet also guarantees the unanticipated — lags between peers, real-world interruptions, hydraulic failures upstream of every abstraction — and those are expected inputs, not anomalies. Without a channel for the unplanned event, reality re-enters the system as corrupted assumptions instead of as a report. This class is the intake organ for canon growth itself: capture -> carry (C5 applies to the capsule) -> collect (bind the LIVE runtime-findings.jsonl + runtime-triage pipeline, do not fork it) -> report -> recover (restored capability — Mishpat, never punishment) -> learn (miss-of-canon feeds the calibration ledger, so the fleet's EXCEPTION-METABOLISM RATE becomes a health measure beside uptime). Peers witness and carry each other's capsules so no node RCAs its own crash alone.

precedent.title: C2 monotonic authority — never backwards, and name the clock
precedent.summary: Selection is decided by declared authority tiers and, within a tier, a NAMED NOTARIZED CLOCK with a deterministic tiebreak — never a conductor-local clock, never arrival order. A move backwards requires proof of forward ordering on that clock; missing ordering evidence refuses the move rather than guessing.
precedent.full_reasoning: CROSS-FAMILY STATEMENT (the class is older and wider than the dataplane). A self-healing loop whose information source is weaker than the state it overwrites converts every restart into a rollback; a fold that reads "latest" as append order re-mints the same defect through replay; a selector ordered by arrival makes index-0 always win. All three are ONE guarantee failing: selection must name the clock it orders on, that clock must be notarized (comparable across the peers that will disagree — a DHT link timestamp, an occurredAt, never a receiving node's local clock), and ties must break deterministically (create_link_hash), or two honest peers converge to two different answers. DATED INCIDENTS. 2026-07-11 (adam-alpha): two minutes after the first-ever cross-conductor adoption, the restarted node's heal restamped the OLD head over the adopted canonical row — 2,838 rows, every restart. The blind first fix keyed the guard on WHO writes and froze forward adoption (a C3 liveness hole created by a C2 cure); the real cure made the SOURCE name the authority it CARRIES (`canonical`), never the writer's identity. 2026-07-12: elohim-host-landing converged at edge #1187's seam-smoke and was healed back to the superseded head by #1188 — a conductor that has not yet integrated a newer canonical link answers with the OLD canonical record: canonical, yet stale. 2026-07-29 (epr-cli/REA): the same guarantee failing in a non-dataplane family, on a projection rather than in DHT truth — which is precisely where C2 and C0 meet. HOW A SEAM ANSWERS THIS ROW. Name the clock; prove the tiebreak is deterministic and permutation-invariant (the `Arbitrated` harness); refuse rather than guess when ordering evidence is missing (NULL either side = refuse); and never key the guard on the writer's identity. This row's `dedupe-of` predicate fires as an ADVISORY at edit time — bind and conform, do not re-derive a local ordering rule at a new seam. The class's mechanizable detector (`epr:validator-heal-fills-never-moves`: a `StampMode::Declare` call site added outside the canonical-channel list, or a stamp-guard edit that cites no contract test) is registered by plan task P4.1; when it lands it arrives as version 2 of this row, and each binding re-declares its pin — the version pin is a declared dependency, never recency.

precedent.title: Liveness — a legal move exists from every reachable state
precedent.summary: From every reachable non-terminal state, at least one AUTOMATED transition is enabled. A human hand (or a deploy) as the only exit is a liveness hole, not an escape hatch.
precedent.full_reasoning: LIVENESS WAS NOBODY'S JOB. Safety rules accrete incident-by-incident and each is locally correct; nothing in the review loop asks whether the conjunction still leaves a move. This class exists to make that question structural: the P2 `Liveness` table harness enumerates a predicate's input state-space and asserts every non-terminal state has >= 1 enabled automated transition, and it is proven to generalize by FAILING against two independently dated historical predicate sets (pre-wave-5 and the 2026-07-11 over-broad GapFill guard) while passing current. The notary-authority REA face — no heal, no contest path, no legal move by construction — is the standing unbound seam.
precedent.scope_json: {"appliesTo":"Every state machine, queue, guard set, breaker, and admission predicate \u2014 and, critically, every COMPOSITION of locally-correct refusals: four independently-correct guards can compose into no-legal-move."}

precedent.title: Honest absence — absent, unreachable, refused and unverifiable are distinct answers
precedent.summary: Absent, unreachable, refused, and unverifiable are distinct answers, and unreadable / unmeasured never reads as zero or complete. On a full-arc fleet a local `get` miss maps to Unreachable (gossip failed), never Absent.
precedent.full_reasoning: The three-way distinction has been re-derived bespoke at least three times (`FetchOutcome`/`RenderTerminal`, the freshness enum's `unverifiable`, `epr-pull-status`'s documented "tri-state" nullable) and collapsed to a bare nullable far more often. The cure is a TYPE, not a convention: `Answer<T>` (Present / Absent / Unreachable) in `seam_contracts`, monomorphic on the wire behind `schemas/v1/objects/answer.schema.json` so the distinction survives the Rust->TS boundary instead of collapsing to null. Standing warning for the first adoption: on a full-arc fleet every zome get/get_links is local-only, so a miss means gossip failed — mapping it to Absent would re-merge exactly what wave 4 separated.

Two standing verification disciplines belong to this class and are stated here so they bind every future contract test: a passing contract test can be MEASURING THE MIRROR (the 2026-07-24 codec bug: compute the two sides independently or the green means nothing), and unevaluatable evidence is symmetric — it may not harden an advisory rule any more than it may soften a gating one.

precedent.title: Idempotent effect — replay against settled state mints nothing and double-applies nothing
precedent.summary: Replaying a decision against settled state mints nothing and double-applies nothing — while never licensing lazy acceptance: storage stays an EAGER reconciliation controller (P1). Quiescence is about EFFECT, not effort.
precedent.full_reasoning: Split out of C6 because the two halves fail differently and are cured differently: C6a is a BUDGET (loud — starvation, OOM, timeout) and C6b is a FIXED POINT (silent — a second identical effect that no counter distinguishes from the first). The anti-lazy clause is load-bearing and stated in the guarantee so no future adoption reads quiescence as permission to stop reconciling: the DHT is the manifest and storage is a k8s-style controller that eagerly reconciles; a `Quiescent` harness proves the replay is a fixed point, never that the controller may sleep.

precedent.title: Observability-per-decision — every outcome increments a labeled counter through a typed reason
precedent.summary: Every decision outcome increments a labeled counter through a TYPED reason (`label()` from an enum, never a raw string); failures are counted beside successes (a ratio is readable, a bare failure count is not); no label is structurally constant; and every meter names its semantics — census or sample — so a rotating-page gauge is never read as a drain.
precedent.full_reasoning: Each wave of the conductor-plane arc was blind until its own meter landed — the instruments could not discriminate WHICH PLANE was refusing, which is why five serial waves were needed for what was one stack. The cure is a compile shape, not a discipline: a `ReasonLabel` trait (`label()`, `all()`) plus a conformance test for unique, stable label sets, so a decision cannot ship without a typed reason. One recurring trap belongs to this class: a hash-typed field in a conductor signal must stay typed (`HoloHashB64`) — a String mirror at the msgpack boundary makes the meter go dark while the decision succeeds. Live-metered: `elohim_content_canonical_answers_total{tier}` gets a runbook invariant->probe row.

precedent.title: Governance escalation ladder — the agency charter
precedent.summary: Governance escalation ladder — the agency charter
precedent.full_reasoning: The agency charter: agents self-grant `measure`/`inject` (+ `dispatch` with a named agent and prompt) freely — observation and advisory-with-directive cannot harm. `ask`/`deny` authorship or promotion is different in kind (it narrows or blocks another agent's future writes) and requires ratified authority from the DELIBERATING COMMUNITY — today the operator+agents working this tree (the "us" of the pre-p2p era), tomorrow a qahal — never agent self-declaration: narrow-never-widen applied to governance itself. Ratification is not a solo stamp; it is PEER ACCEPTANCE AT THE BRANCH RUNG: the branch ladder is the repo's reach axis (shift/* = self; dev = community; main = commons), a governance rule on a shift branch is structurally pending, and the dev-merge acceptance IS the ratification event — the CanonizationRef of repo governance (accepting a merge includes accepting the rules we govern ourselves by). This validator fires when a `.epr-meta` write INTRODUCES an ask|deny rule (a brand-new manifest: any ask|deny rule; an existing one: compared against its prior on-disk content, so unrelated edits to an already-governed manifest never retrigger) that is not backed by a `policy: <id>@<version>` binding whose registry row's `established_by` carries deliberation provenance (`deliberated-*`, or the legacy `operator-*` rows predating this convention). An INLINE ask|deny rule with no policy binding at all is never backed: the charter requires the deliberated registry pin for that class, not a rule authored directly in the manifest. `ask` tier: routes to review (refer_reason `escalation-requires-ratification`) rather than hard-blocking, since the gate cannot itself adjudicate ratification — only an operator can. Known v1 scope gap: `when` patterns match by BASENAME only (`_matches_when` in _lib/epr_meta.py), so this binding's `.epr-meta` scope covers the legacy flat manifest form but not the directory form (`.epr-meta/manifest.md`, basename `manifest.md`) — tighten if/when that form sees adoption. Bound at the repo root (not `.claude/epr-meta/.epr-meta`): `when` patterns are basename-only and the cascade is a strict ancestor walk, so a manifest placed anywhere other than the repo root can only ever govern writes BENEATH itself — it cannot reach out to unrelated directories. A repo-wide charter needs the repo-root anchor.

precedent.title: Source-file LoC ceiling — architecture-review trigger
precedent.summary: Source-file LoC ceiling — architecture-review trigger
precedent.full_reasoning: A first-party source file past the hard ceiling is a god-file: it corrodes its own governance (line-number invariant anchors drift every edit; two-location sync traps grow ~1000 lines apart) and outgrows what one context window can review. Soft ceiling = edit-time nudge (new logic likely belongs in a module). Hard ceiling = a fingerprinted architecture finding: canonicalize a modularization plan into the timeline backlog and drive it as bounded work — never refactor mid-edit. Refactor-safety asymmetry the reviewer must honor: coordinator zomes hot-swap via update_coordinators (cheap); integrity-zome changes move the DNA hash (reinstall/partition trap — ride a deliberate DNA-lineage event only); plain native Rust is gated by fmt/clippy/nextest alone. Ratchet ceilings DOWN as the tail drains; never up.

precedent.title: Sovereignty ontology guard — affirm the frame, never assert the apex
precedent.summary: Sovereignty ontology guard — affirm the frame, never assert the apex
precedent.full_reasoning: The Elohim ontology REJECTS crypto self-sovereignty as an apex value (canon: genesis/docs/architecture/stewardship-over-sovereignty.md — "we do not consider sovereignty itself to be the right framing"; values-forward.md Stance II.4 — "sovereignty is not forbidden, it is made mechanically expensive"). A human's identity is imago dei — an inviolable right BACKSTOPPED by community/institutional expression, not a self-asserted crypto primitive; real agency comes from community backstopping the individual. This guard fires on NET-NEW apex framing (self-sovereign as the top identity/agency tier; "true/full data sovereignty" as a goal) — it is an AFFIRMATION prompt, not a ban. Confirm your usage is one of the three LEGITIMATE frames and proceed, or reframe: (1) ADVERSARY — naming what is resisted (surveillance capitalism) or external actors ("near-sovereign yet subject to the protocol"); (2) BOUNDED — "sovereign WITHIN higher bounds", the collective human floor sovereign over the machine; (3) BRIDGE-LEGIBILITY — a self-sovereign wallet making a participant legible to EXTERNAL sovereigns (a credit union/mutual), where head/ceiling/authority still flow from the commons governance pool. If your surface's frame is already adjudicated (the wallet bridge), declare it once — a `sovereignty-frame:` marker in the doc, or a nearest-wins `.epr-meta` override on this rule id — and the guard goes quiet. Parallel rules (the story of why, followable): the DESIGN-TIME sibling is the p2p-design-gate skill's Identity Ontology Guard (same discipline, fired before you design a tier, not as you write it); the LIFE-STAGE companion is genesis/docs/architecture/cradle-to-grave-capability-gradient.md (why unqualified self-sovereignty can't model wards/IDD/seniors — the right is exercised WITH/THROUGH others). Dismissals aggregate to sovereignty-guard-signal.py so the RULE itself surfaces for drift review: the protocol governing the bytes of its own repo.
